global_options.description: Global DRBD options (e.g., minor-count, user-click-on-resync, etc.). Refer to drbd.conf(5) for valid keys.

minor-count.description: Number of minor devices DRBD should prepare for (max 255).

user-click-on-resync.description: Allow manual resync control via /proc/drbd. Set to 'yes' or 'no'.

history-size.description: Number of peer history entries to retain per resource.
